texts.facts: Instant application has been filed with prayer to quash the entire criminal proceeding of Criminal Complaint Case No. 7965 of 2023, under Section-26 (2) (11)/59 (1), 26 (2) (II)/51 The Food Safety and Standards Act 2006, Police Station-Kotwali City, District-Raebareli as well as impugned summoning order dated 13.4.2023 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate 1, Rae Bareli in the aforesaid complaint case. Leaned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant matter.
